	Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies for farm products.

	Ogwashi-Uku: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred).

Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.

Marketing Officer Job at Vista Organic Farm




        
    

        
        Vista Organic Farm is a growing agricultural enterprise engaged in poultry production, animal husbandry, and crop farming. We are committed to maintaining high standards in farm operations, animal welfare, and sustainable agriculture.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Marketing Officer

Job Location: Ogwashi Uku, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Vista Organic Farm Ltd is seeking an experienced, energetic and results-driven Farm Produce Marketing & Sales Officer to drive the sales and market expansion of the company's agricultural and livestock products.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for developing markets and securing customers for chickens, eggs, fish, vegetables, grains, tubers, processed farm products and other agricultural commodities produced by Vista Farm.
	This is a highly commercial role requiring someone who understands how to take farm produce from the farm to the market, identify profitable buyers, negotiate sales, develop distribution channels and build long-term relationships with customers.
	The ideal candidate must have demonstrable experience marketing and selling agricultural or farm products, preferably with an existing network of buyers, distributors, retailers, restaurants, hotels, supermarkets, food businesses and other institutional customers.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute sales and marketing strategies for farm products.
	Identify and secure new customers, distributors, wholesalers, retailers, restaurants, hotels, supermarkets and other bulk buyers.
	Build and maintain strong customer relationships and drive repeat sales.
	Conduct market research and monitor product pricing, demand and competition.
	Generate leads through field sales, networking, telephone and digital marketing.
	Negotiate sales and supply arrangements within approved company guidelines.
	Achieve agreed monthly and quarterly sales targets.
	Prepare regular sales and market reports.


Requirements


	HND/Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Agriculture, Agribusiness or a related field.
	2–4 years of proven experience in marketing and selling farm produce, poultry, eggs, fish or other agricultural products.
	Strong knowledge of agricultural markets and distribution channels.
	Proven ability to generate leads, acquire customers and close sales.
	Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-management skills.
	Experience dealing with wholesalers, retailers, restaurants, hotels, supermarkets or institutional buyers is an advantage.
	An existing network of farm produce buyers/distributors will be highly advantageous.
	Must be target-driven, proactive and willing to conduct field sales and market visits.
	Ability to commute/relocate:
	Ogwashi-Uku: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred).


What We Offer

Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Marketing Officer" as subject of the mail.    

    

        Click here to Apply

Human Resources Officer Job at Fortune Heights Farms Limited




        
    

        
        Fortune Heights Farms Limited is an agro-allied livestock production company located along Old Ikenne Road in Odogbolu, Ogun State, Nigeria. The commercial farm specializes in high-yield aquaculture (catfish) and poultry farming, producing commercial quantities of table eggs and frozen chicken products. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resources Officer

Job Location: Odogbolu, Ogun

Requirements
     

            
    




	Candidates should possess relevant qualifications with experience.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: If you have a background in agriculture (or just a love for it!) and are ready to take your career to the next level in a dynamic environment, we want to hear from you.

  "description": "SIMS Nigeria Limited - For over three decades, SIMS Nigeria Limited has grown from a single store to a nationwide business in the consumer electronics space with locations across Nigeria.   "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Financial Accountant",
  "description": "Mwanga is a pioneer tech-driven debt recovery and business support outsourcing company with a vision to be the leading extension to global teams in Africa. We started our pilot operations in 2018 with a small agile team and have scaled impressively since then in results and team becoming trusted by key players for recoveries in Nigeria. We offer business support to businesses with the aim of helping them scale using ethical and innovative technology strategies. We are trusted by Africa&rsquo;s leading lenders to recover their outstanding debts and to scale our impact. We provide a range of services ranging from debt recovery, telemarketing, call center outsourcing, virtual assistant services, customer support services, and data analysis.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Financial&nbsp;Accountant

Job Location: Maryland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Chief of Staff (day-to-day); dotted lines - Country Lead &amp; CEO (strategic decisions)

Context


	Financial discipline is existential.
	This role protects that discipline of revenue management while supporting the growth plan.
	The role is the financial intelligence engine of a company in transformation.


Key Responsibilities


	Produce monthly management accounts (P&amp;L by service line, cost variance, summary with recommendations) and quarterly financial reviews covering full P&amp;L, cash position, and forecast.
	Maintain the rolling financial model with monthly actuals, and deliver financial scenario models (base, growth, and risk cases) plus unit economics for any new service line or client proposal within an agreed turnaround time.
	Lead the annual budget process, compile HOD inputs, build the consolidated budget, present for CEO approval, and monitor performance against it monthly, including revenue diversification tracking across all service lines.
	Own all bookkeeping - chart of accounts, fixed asset register, bank reconciliations, and journals, in the company&#39;s accounting software, configured by service line, with all financial documents filed consistently in SharePoint and accessible to the CEO and auditors at all times.
	Manage invoicing across all clients and currencies, chase overdue payments within agreed timelines, update accounts receivable in the financial model regularly, and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast with adequate early warning on any cash pressure.
	Process payroll accurately and on time with correct tax and pension deductions, and handle petty cash and expense claims within agreed timelines.
	Own all tax and statutory filings (VAT, CIT, PAYE, and pension), submitted on time, and manage relationships with external auditors and tax advisors for annual accounts, audit preparation, and tax planning.
	Monitor foreign exchange exposure on hard-currency client revenue, advise on Naira conversion timing, and manage multi-currency reconciliation and payout optimization through international payment platforms.
	Ensure financial records comply with data protection requirements, and build a structured ROI case for every significant spend decision before CEO approval.
	Integrate the accounting system with the financial model so actuals flow automatically, and own the finance component of staff onboarding - bank details, pension enrolment, expense policy, and payroll setup completed before every new hire&#39;s first day.


Requirements / Skills / Qualifications


	2 to 3 years in a finance or accounting role with management accounts, payroll, invoicing, and cash flow all hands-on experience.
	Professional qualification or progress toward one - ICAN, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent.
	Strong Excel or Google Sheets experience. Also, knowledge of Microsoft Office tools like SharePoint and OneDrive is an advantage.
	Experience in using Sage accounting software is a plus.
	Experience with Nigerian tax compliance (VAT, CIT, PAYE), pension, filed without external prompting
	Attention to detail that borders on obsessive, professional, organised, and good with presentation.
	Experience in a services business, understands revenue recognition, project-based costing, and multi-client billing.
	Takes initiative and is cut-throat with order in the books.


Salary Range
N200,000 - N250,000 net per month.&nbsp;

Note


	Interested candidates should fill out the Google Form attached below.
	Please upload an updated CV.

Financial Accountant Job at Mwanga Limited




        
    

        
        Mwanga is a pioneer tech-driven debt recovery and business support outsourcing company with a vision to be the leading extension to global teams in Africa. We started our pilot operations in 2018 with a small agile team and have scaled impressively since then in results and team becoming trusted by key players for recoveries in Nigeria. We offer business support to businesses with the aim of helping them scale using ethical and innovative technology strategies. We are trusted by Africa’s leading lenders to recover their outstanding debts and to scale our impact. We provide a range of services ranging from debt recovery, telemarketing, call center outsourcing, virtual assistant services, customer support services, and data analysis. 
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Financial Accountant

Job Location: Maryland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Chief of Staff (day-to-day); dotted lines - Country Lead & CEO (strategic decisions)

Context


	Financial discipline is existential.
	This role protects that discipline of revenue management while supporting the growth plan.
	The role is the financial intelligence engine of a company in transformation.


Key Responsibilities


	Produce monthly management accounts (P&L by service line, cost variance, summary with recommendations) and quarterly financial reviews covering full P&L, cash position, and forecast.
	Maintain the rolling financial model with monthly actuals, and deliver financial scenario models (base, growth, and risk cases) plus unit economics for any new service line or client proposal within an agreed turnaround time.
	Lead the annual budget process, compile HOD inputs, build the consolidated budget, present for CEO approval, and monitor performance against it monthly, including revenue diversification tracking across all service lines.
	Own all bookkeeping - chart of accounts, fixed asset register, bank reconciliations, and journals, in the company's accounting software, configured by service line, with all financial documents filed consistently in SharePoint and accessible to the CEO and auditors at all times.
	Manage invoicing across all clients and currencies, chase overdue payments within agreed timelines, update accounts receivable in the financial model regularly, and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast with adequate early warning on any cash pressure.
	Process payroll accurately and on time with correct tax and pension deductions, and handle petty cash and expense claims within agreed timelines.
	Own all tax and statutory filings (VAT, CIT, PAYE, and pension), submitted on time, and manage relationships with external auditors and tax advisors for annual accounts, audit preparation, and tax planning.
	Monitor foreign exchange exposure on hard-currency client revenue, advise on Naira conversion timing, and manage multi-currency reconciliation and payout optimization through international payment platforms.
	Ensure financial records comply with data protection requirements, and build a structured ROI case for every significant spend decision before CEO approval.
	Integrate the accounting system with the financial model so actuals flow automatically, and own the finance component of staff onboarding - bank details, pension enrolment, expense policy, and payroll setup completed before every new hire's first day.


Requirements / Skills / Qualifications


	2 to 3 years in a finance or accounting role with management accounts, payroll, invoicing, and cash flow all hands-on experience.
	Professional qualification or progress toward one - ICAN, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent.
	Strong Excel or Google Sheets experience. Also, knowledge of Microsoft Office tools like SharePoint and OneDrive is an advantage.
	Experience in using Sage accounting software is a plus.
	Experience with Nigerian tax compliance (VAT, CIT, PAYE), pension, filed without external prompting
	Attention to detail that borders on obsessive, professional, organised, and good with presentation.
	Experience in a services business, understands revenue recognition, project-based costing, and multi-client billing.
	Takes initiative and is cut-throat with order in the books.


Salary Range
N200,000 - N250,000 net per month.
